history.p: Together with "Hellig Trekongers-Kvad" (HartW 184), the present work is the closest Hartmann got to the oratorio genre with its monumental, polyphonic choirs.

incipText.p: De Døde kunne ikke love Herren
Die Todten können nicht loben den Herren
The dead, they can not praise the Lord
Doch wir wollen loben den Herren
But now we will praise the Lord
